name: mikedown-editor
description: A true WYSIWYG Markdown editor for VS Code — edit markdown visually, right in your editor tabs.

commands.title: MikeDown: Make MikeDown the Default Markdown Editor

mikedown.defaultEditor.description: Whether MikeDown Editor is the default editor for Markdown files. When enabled, .md files open in WYSIWYG mode by default.

enumDescriptions: Always show the sidebar when a document opens (matches pinning the sidebar in the header)
Start hidden; use the toggle button to surface it for the current document
mikedown.sidebar.visibility.description: Whether the in-editor sidebar starts visible. Toggle the pin button in the sidebar header to change this.

mikedown.support.showSidebarLink.description: Show a small Support MikeDown link in the in-editor sidebar footer. Does not affect the Support MikeDown entry in Settings, About or the MikeDown: Support MikeDown command.

mikedown.sidebar.width.description: Width of the in-editor sidebar, in pixels.

enumDescriptions: Show the sidebar on the left side of the editor
Show the sidebar on the right side of the editor
mikedown.sidebar.position.description: Which side of the editor the sidebar renders on.

mikedown.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Font family for the WYSIWYG editing area. Use the settings panel in the editor (gear icon) to preview fonts live.
enumDescriptions: System Default — native OS font
Arial — universal sans-serif
Verdana — wide, screen-optimized
Georgia — elegant serif
Times New Roman — classic serif
Palatino — book-quality serif
Consolas / Menlo — clean monospace
Courier New — traditional monospace

mikedown.headingFontFamily.markdownDescription: Font family for headings. Leave empty to use the same font as the body text, or use the font theme picker in the editor toolbar.

mikedown.fontSize.description: Font size (in pixels) for the WYSIWYG editing area.

mikedown.ctrlWheelZoom.description: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) and scroll the mouse wheel, or pinch on a trackpad, to change the editor font size.

enumDescriptions: Cmd+Click navigates to the link in the current editor tab
Cmd+Click opens the link in a new editor tab
Cmd+Click always shows a context menu with navigation options
mikedown.linkClickBehavior.description: What happens when you Cmd+Click (Mac) or Ctrl+Click (Windows/Linux) on a link in WYSIWYG mode.

enumDescriptions: Toggle light/dark mode only within MikeDown editor tabs
Toggle VS Code's global light/dark theme
mikedown.themeToggleScope.description: Whether the toolbar theme toggle affects only MikeDown editors or VS Code's global theme.

enumDescriptions: Follow VS Code's current theme
Always use light mode in MikeDown editors
Always use dark mode in MikeDown editors
mikedown.editorTheme.description: Override the editor theme for MikeDown tabs. The toolbar sun/moon button toggles this when themeToggleScope is 'editorOnly'.

mikedown.autoReloadUnmodifiedFiles.description: Automatically reload unmodified files when external changes are detected, without prompting.

mikedown.renderMermaidDiagrams.description: Render ```mermaid code blocks as diagrams in the editor. Click a diagram to edit its source.

mikedown.renderMath.description: Render $inline$ and $$display$$ LaTeX math with KaTeX. Click a formula to edit it. When off, formulas show as their raw source.

mikedown.tags.enabled.description: Highlight inline #tags, suggest existing workspace tags as you type #, and show a Tags section in the sidebar. Cmd/Ctrl+click a tag to find the documents that carry it.

enumDescriptions: Preserve original markdown syntax choices (default list markers, heading styles, etc.)
Normalize markdown to a consistent style on save
mikedown.markdownNormalization.description: Whether to normalize markdown syntax when saving.

enumDescriptions: Prompt before updating cross-file links when a heading is renamed (in-document table-of-contents links are fixed automatically)
Update all affected links automatically when a heading is renamed (still undoable)
Never update links when a heading is renamed
mikedown.headingRename.updateLinks.description: When you rename a heading, links that point at its anchor (#slug) break. This controls whether MikeDown fixes them. In-document links are always fixed silently; this setting governs cross-file links in other markdown files.

enumDescriptions: No heading numbers and no toolbar button
Number every heading level, starting at H1 (1, 1.1, 1.1.1)
Treat H1 as the document title and start numbering at H2
mikedown.headingNumbering.description: Adds a toolbar button that writes section numbers into heading text (## 1.2 Setup) and keeps them updated as you edit. The numbers are part of the markdown, so they show in every renderer.

version.description: Schema version of the layout. Currently 1.

items.description: Toolbar item ids in order. "|" is a separator and "~" is a flexible spacer.

seen.description: Toolbar item ids this layout has already been reconciled against. New buttons added by an update that are not listed here are inserted automatically.

mikedown.toolbarLayout.markdownDescription: Your customized toolbar layout. To change it, open MikeDown's Settings (the gear in the editor toolbar), go to the Toolbar tab and choose Customize Toolbar, or right-click the toolbar. Changes save when you click Done. Reset to Default clears this value. Stored in your user settings, so Settings Sync carries it to your other machines.

enumDescriptions: A nested list of heading links between <!-- toc --> and <!-- tocstop --> markers, so the table of contents works on GitHub and in any renderer
A single [toc] line, which GitLab, Typora and many static site tools expand when they render; MikeDown shows it as a live table of contents
mikedown.tocStyle.description: What Insert > Table of Contents (and /toc) adds. Existing tables of contents keep their style, and both styles are always recognized when a file is opened.

mikedown.normalizationStyle.boldMarker.description: Which bold marker to use when normalization is enabled.

mikedown.normalizationStyle.italicMarker.description: Which italic marker to use when normalization is enabled.

mikedown.normalizationStyle.listMarker.description: Which unordered list marker to use when normalization is enabled.

enumDescriptions: ATX-style headings: # Heading 1, ## Heading 2
Setext-style headings: Heading 1 with === underline, Heading 2 with --- underline
mikedown.normalizationStyle.headingStyle.description: Which heading style to use when normalization is enabled.

mikedown.imagePaste.enabled.description: Save pasted or drag-dropped images to the workspace and insert a markdown image link automatically. When disabled, falls back to VS Code's default paste behavior.

mikedown.imagePaste.folder.markdownDescription: Folder name (or relative path) where pasted images are saved. Created if it does not exist. Supports `${docName}` for a folder per document, e.g. `assets/${docName}`.

enumDescriptions: Folder is resolved relative to the markdown document's directory
Folder is resolved relative to the workspace root
mikedown.imagePaste.folderRelativeTo.description: Where the imagePaste.folder is resolved from.

mikedown.imagePaste.filenamePattern.markdownDescription: Pattern for generated image filenames (extension is appended automatically). Tokens: `${docName}`, `${date}` (YYYYMMDD), `${time}` (HHmmss), `${timestamp}` (date+time), `${hash}` (8-char content hash, enables dedupe), `${index}` (auto-increment).

enumDescriptions: Insert path relative to the markdown document
Insert path relative to the workspace root, prefixed with /
mikedown.imagePaste.pathStyle.description: Path style written into the inserted markdown image link.

enumDescriptions: Insert images with empty alt text
Use the filename (without extension) as alt text
Prompt for alt text on every paste
mikedown.imagePaste.altText.description: How to populate alt text for pasted images.

mikedown.imagePaste.maxSizeMB.description: Maximum size (in MB) for a single pasted image. Larger pastes are rejected with an error.

mikedown.imagePaste.cleanupUnreferenced.markdownDescription: When you save the document, delete images inside the `imagePaste.folder` that were previously referenced (or pasted in this session) and are no longer referenced by **any** markdown file in the workspace. Files outside the configured folder are never touched.

mikedown.imageResize.overwrite.description: When resizing an image from the popover, overwrite the original file. When disabled, write a sibling file (e.g. foo-50pct.png) and update the markdown link to point at it.

mikedown.wikilink.createOnClick.description: Obsidian-style: when you Cmd/Ctrl+Click an unresolved [[wikilink]] whose target file doesn't exist yet, create the markdown file (in the current document's folder) and open it. When off, unresolved wikilinks do nothing on click.

mikedown.spellCheck.enabled.description: Underline misspelled words in the MikeDown editor. Off by default while the feature settles; turn it on here or in the editor's Settings → Spelling tab. VS Code disables the browser's built-in spell checker for all webviews, so MikeDown ships its own dictionary. When off, no dictionary is loaded at all.

enumDescriptions: English (United States)
English (United Kingdom)
mikedown.spellCheck.language.description: Which English dictionary the spell checker uses.

mikedown.spellCheck.ignoreCodeBlocks.description: Skip fenced code blocks (including mermaid diagrams) and `inline code` when spell checking. Links and [[wikilinks]] are always skipped.

mikedown.spellCheck.userWords.description: Custom dictionary — words the spell checker should always accept. Right-click a flagged word and choose "Add to Dictionary" to add to this list. Words configured for the Code Spell Checker extension (cSpell.words) are also honoured, read-only.

mikedown.slashCommands.enabled.description: Show the slash command menu when typing / at the start of a line or after whitespace.

enumDescriptions: September 26, 2026
mikedown.slashCommands.dateFormat.description: Date format used by the /date and /datetime slash commands.

mikedown.slashCommands.timeZone.description: Time zone used by the /date and /datetime slash commands: "local", "UTC", or an IANA zone name like America/New_York.

mikedown.ai.enabled.description: Master switch for MikeDown's AI features. Off by default; nothing is sent anywhere while it is off. It turns on by itself when AI setup finishes with an engine and a default model (the toolbar AI button, then Set up). Edit these in the MikeDown Settings modal (toolbar gear, AI tab).

mikedown.ai.showToolbarButton.description: Show the AI button on the MikeDown toolbar. While AI is off, it offers to turn AI on and set up an engine. Edit it in the MikeDown Settings modal (toolbar gear, AI tab).

mikedown.ai.allowCloud.markdownDescription: Allow AI engines whose address is not local (cloud APIs, and GitHub Copilot). Even when on, MikeDown asks once per workspace before it sends text to a cloud engine, and asks again if that engine's address changes; the answers are listed under Cloud consents in the AI tab. Choosing a cloud provider or Copilot in AI setup turns this on. User settings only, so a repository cannot turn cloud on for you. Edit it in the MikeDown Settings modal (toolbar gear, AI tab).

mikedown.ai.engines.markdownDescription: The AI engines MikeDown can use (oMLX, LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible servers, Anthropic, OpenAI and other cloud providers, GitHub Copilot) and the models each one serves. User settings only, so a repository cannot add an endpoint. API keys are never stored here: they live in VS Code's secret storage, or come from the environment variable named in `apiKeyEnv` or the JSON file named in `apiKeyFile`. Edit engines in the MikeDown Settings modal (toolbar gear, AI tab).

id.description: Stable id, generated once. Do not change it: routes and the stored API key refer to it.

baseUrl.description: Required except for GitHub Copilot (kind vscode-lm), which has no address. For example http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 or https://api.anthropic.com.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable to read the API key from when none is stored, for example OMLX_API_KEY.

apiKeyFile.description: A JSON file in your home folder to read the API key from when none is stored and the environment variable is unset, for example oMLX's ~/.omlx/settings.json with jsonPath auth.api_key.

jsonPath.description: Dotted path to a string value in the file, for example auth.api_key.

requestOverrides.description: Merged into the request body last, for example { "reasoning_effort": "low" }.

mikedown.ai.routing.markdownDescription: Which engine and model serve each AI task (the Tasks page of the AI Engines page), and what happens when that one is unavailable. Edit these in the MikeDown Settings modal (toolbar gear, AI tab).

mikedown.ai.features.markdownDescription: Per-feature switches and task overrides, keyed by feature id, for example { "rewrite": { "enabled": true } }. Edit these in the MikeDown Settings modal (toolbar gear, AI tab).

mikedown.ai.localNetworks.markdownDescription: IPv4 ranges (CIDR) and host name suffixes that count as local, besides loopback, link-local, `.local`, `.lan` and `.home.arpa`. Add a WireGuard range such as `10.0.98.0/24` or `.ts.net` here. User settings only. Edit it under Advanced: local networks on the AI tab of the MikeDown Settings modal, or here.

scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:core && npm run build -w packages/desktop
scripts.test:desktop: npm run test:unit -w packages/desktop && npm run test:e2e -w packages/desktop
scripts.vsix: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run package && vsce package
scripts.vsix:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run package && vsce package
scripts.test:angular: npm run build:core && npm test --prefix packages/angular/test-app
scripts.test:site: npm run build:site && npm run test:site:built
scripts.test:wrappers: npm run test:web-component && npm run test:react && npm run test:vue && npm run test:angular
